I filled the hole with `epi→hom 𝑨 (𝑨 ╱ θ) (πepi h θ)`, and check_file reports success on the final file (exit code 0, no holes, only two deprecation warnings from inside the library).

That expression turns the library's quotient-map epimorphism `πepi h θ` into an ordinary homomorphism from 𝑨 to 𝑨 ╱ θ. My first try, `epi→hom (𝑨 ╱ θ) (πepi θ)`, failed to type-check because `πepi` takes the homomorphism `h` before `θ`, and `epi→hom` needs both algebras given explicitly.
